body_md:
\label{Cor1}Under the conditions of Theorem \ref{T_reduced}, for any $y\in
(0,\infty )$ 
\begin{eqnarray*}
&&\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\mathbf{P}\left( Z(n-y\varphi
(n),n)=1|\mathcal{H}(n,\varphi (n))\right)\\
&&\qquad\qquad\quad=\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty }\mathbf{P}\left(
d(n)\leq y\varphi (n)|\mathcal{H}(n,\varphi (n))\right)
=\alpha\Gamma (1+\alpha) yM(y^{-1/\alpha }).
\end{eqnarray*}
